memberships.page_title: The Root-Slope Mechanism and Cubic Cover Geometry

statement: Over A(c) nonzero, the normalized cubic discriminant complement is the product of the punctured c-line and the centered three-point configuration space; if A has s distinct roots, its fundamental group is F_s times B_3 and the permutation monodromy is the standard B_3-to-S3 quotient.
